ComputedDependency.subordinates: A summary task takes its dates, its duration and its progress from its subtasks.
ComputedDependency.lines_and_subordinates: The amount of a task is that of the lines it bears and of its subtasks.
ComputedDependency.scheduling: A task in automatic mode takes its dates from its duration, its links and the calendar.
ComputedDependency.float_dates: The total float of a task is the gap between its earliest and latest dates.
ComputedDependency.manual_mode: A task in manual mode bears no float.
ComputedDependency.hourly_rate: The amount of a labour line is the product of its quantity, its effort and the hourly rate of its category for the reference year, projected onto its year of consumption.
ComputedDependency.unit_disbursement: The amount of a non-labour line is the product of its quantity and its unit disbursement, projected onto its year of consumption.
ComputedDependency.risk: A provision line takes its figures from its risk: its severity weighted by its probability.
ComputedDependency.reference_revision: The budgeted amount is the one the reference revision set.
ComputedDependency.remaining_reviews: The re-estimated amount follows the reviews of the estimate to complete.
ComputedDependency.inflation: The inflation-corrected amount is the line’s amount projected on its year of consumption at the project’s inflation rate.
